dcf.note: Grid offsets are added to the base growth and discount rate. Cells where discount <= terminal growth are left empty.

insider.note: Form 4 transaction code P = open-market purchase, S = open-market sale. Awards, option exercises and tax withholding are ignored. Sales are frequently pre-scheduled (10b5-1) so they carry less signal than purchases.

institutional.note: 13F filings are per manager, not per stock. Add manager CIKs to tracked_managers to see whether they added to or trimmed a position quarter over quarter. Empty by default: no manager list is assumed.

narrative.note: A number in LLM text counts as supported if it matches a number in the input JSON (as-is, x100 for percents, or scaled by K/M/B/T) within the tolerance or its own displayed rounding. Years are ignored.

budget.note: Token estimates are characters / 4; budgets trim the long filing excerpts, never the computed metrics.
